name: SM80 GEMM Universal with multistage threadblock MMA
summary: Compose an Ampere multistage threadblock MMA and epilogue into a universal GEMM kernel supporting standard, split-K, batched, and array execution modes.

strategy.intent: Turn a tuned SM80 mainloop into a complete, broadly usable GEMM kernel.
strategy.mechanism: Map grid tiles through a swizzle, run the multistage MMA over K partitions, and apply an output epilogue under the selected universal GEMM mode.
strategy.expected_benefit: Reuses one optimized kernel structure across common GEMM execution modes and problem layouts.
tradeoffs: Split-K modes require additional reduction or synchronization handling.
Grid swizzle and split-K choices are workload dependent.

parameters.name: threadblock_swizzle
parameters.description: Mapping from CUDA blocks to GEMM tiles.

constraints.expression: Mma and Epilogue have compatible accumulator fragments
constraints.rationale: The epilogue consumes the threadblock MMA accumulator tile.

constraints.expression: mode-specific batch strides or pointer arrays are valid
constraints.rationale: Universal modes interpret tensor references differently.
Kernel shared storage overlays mainloop and epilogue storage.

references.evidence: The kernel composes Mma, Epilogue, swizzle, universal mode arguments, tiled grid shape, and mode-dependent execution.
